def process_input(input_chars, output_writer):
    current_index = 0
    max_sequence = 0
    total_pairs = 0
    in_parentheses = False
    length = len(input_chars)
    while current_index < length:
        if input_chars[current_index] == '(':
            in_parentheses = True
        elif input_chars[current_index] == ')':
            in_parentheses = False
        elif input_chars[current_index].isalpha():
            current_index -= 1
        if in_parentheses:
            while (current_index + 1) < length and input_chars[current_index + 1] != ')' and not input_chars[current_index + 1].isalpha():
                current_index += 1
            if (current_index + 1) == length or not input_chars[current_index + 1].isalpha():
                current_index += 1
                continue
            current_index += 1
            while (current_index + 1) < length and input_chars[current_index + 1].isalpha():
                current_index += 1
            total_pairs += 1
        else:
            while (current_index + 1) < length and input_chars[current_index + 1] != '(' and not input_chars[current_index + 1].isalpha():
                current_index += 1
            if (current_index + 1) == length or not input_chars[current_index + 1].isalpha():
                current_index += 1
                continue
            start_idx = current_index + 1
            current_index = start_idx
            while (current_index + 1) < length and input_chars[current_index + 1].isalpha():
                current_index += 1
            max_sequence = max(max_sequence, current_index - start_idx + 1)
        current_index += 1
    output_writer.write(str(max_sequence) + " " + str(total_pairs) + "\n")

def main():
    import sys
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    # The first line is ignored as per original code
    if len(input_lines) >= 2:
        _ = input_lines[0]
        line = input_lines[1]
        process_input(list(line), sys.stdout)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
